text:
He will most likely be found not guilty. Arson requires malice, meaning intent or reckless disregard of a known risk of fire. Forgetting to turn off the stove is mere negligence, and voluntary intoxication doesn't turn it into recklessness. Of the two options given, "not guilty, because the defendant did not commit a felony" is the closer fit, though its wording is odd.

CONFIDENCE: 66
